test_TorchscriptHook_constructors: test the TorchscriptHook constructor with valid and invalid config parameters
run_torchscript_using_trace: run the TorchscriptHook on_start and on_end hooks using trace mode to save a torchscript model
run_torchscript_using_script: run the TorchscriptHook on_start and on_end hooks using script mode with use_trace set to False
test_torchscript_output_match: test that the torchscript model output matches the original model output using torch.allclose
build_task_from_config: build a task from a config using build_task and prepare it for torchscript hook execution
